title: Redistributive Policies for the Times of Transformative AI
abstract: arXiv:2609.14750v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: After the arrival of transformative artificial intelligence (TAI), broad-based automation is expected to decrease the labor share and increase income and wealth inequality. Although economic growth is likely to accelerate, most of its gains may accrue to a narrow group of individuals and firms. Hence, if unmitigated by redistributive policy, income and wealth inequality may rise to levels unseen in the industrial economy. Using a unifying theoretical framework, we survey the redistributive policies proposed for the era of TAI, such as universal basic income (UBI), universal basic capital (UBC), state-issued compute and robot permits, and taxes on capital, compute, robots, tokens, land, energy, consumption, and wealth. We argue that policies that are able to broadly distribute rents from capital including compute and robots - such as UBC or UBI financed through capital taxes - are most likely to achieve lasting reductions in inequality in

translated_title: 变革性人工智能时代的再分配政策
translated_abstract: 在变革性人工智能（TAI）到来之后，大范围的自动化预计将降低劳动收入份额，并加剧收入与财富不平等。尽管经济增长可能会加速，但其大部分收益可能会归于少数个人和企业。因此，如果缺乏再分配政策的调节，收入和财富不平等可能上升到工业经济时代从未见过的水平。我们采用一个统一的理论框架，综述了为TAI时代提出的各类再分配政策，例如全民基本收入（UBI）、全民基本资本（UBC）、国家发放的算力与机器人许可证，以及对资本、算力、机器人、代币、土地、能源、消费和财富的征税。我们认为，能够广泛分配资本租金（包括算力和机器人租金）的政策——如通过资本税融资的UBC或UBI——最有可能实现不平等程度的持久下降。
tldr: 本文在统一理论框架下综述了变革性AI时代的各类再分配政策，并论证通过资本税融资的全民基本资本或全民基本收入等能广泛分配资本租金的政策，最有可能持久地降低不平等。
en_tdlr: This paper surveys redistributive policies for the era of transformative AI within a unifying framework, arguing that policies broadly distributing capital rents—such as UBC or UBI financed through capital taxes—are most likely to achieve lasting reductions in inequality.
